entry.title: Awesome Qgis Updates on Mar 30 - Apr 05, 2026
entry.content:
Official Resources

  • QGIS Official Website - Main project website with downloads, news, and documentation.
  • GitHub Repository (⭐14k) - Source code repository for QGIS core.
  • Visual Changelogs - Illustrated changelogs for each QGIS release.
  • Roadmap - Release schedule and development roadmap.
  • Case Studies - Real-world QGIS usage examples from various industries.
  • Visual Style Guide - Official branding and visual identity guidelines.

Documentation

  • User Manual - Complete QGIS desktop user documentation.
  • Server Guide - Documentation for QGIS Server.
  • Training Manual - Step-by-step training manual for learning QGIS.
  • Gentle Introduction to GIS - Beginner-friendly introduction to GIS concepts.

Plugins / Data Management

  • QuickOSM - Download OpenStreetMap data directly using the Overpass API.
  • OSMDownloader - Download OSM data by selecting an area on the map.
  • Lat Lon Tools - Capture and zoom to coordinates in multiple formats.
  • mmqgis - Collection of vector layer operation tools including geocoding and merging.
  • KML Tools - Fast KML and KMZ import and export.
  • Digitizing Tools - Enhanced tools for vector geometry editing sessions.
  • Shape Tools - Create geodesic shapes, measure bearings, and flip coordinates.
  • Point Sampling Tool - Sample raster and polygon values at point locations.
  • GeoCoding - Forward and reverse address lookup via Nominatim and Google.

Plugins / Basemaps and Web Services

  • QuickMapServices - Easy basemap addition from OpenStreetMap, Google, Bing, and more.
  • HCMGIS - Basemaps, OpenData download, and batch conversion tools.
  • Street View - Google Street View and other street-level imagery integration.
  • MetaSearch Catalogue Client - Interact with OGC CSW metadata catalogue services.
  • GeoBasis Loader - Quick insertion of free geoservices and basemaps.

Plugins / Analysis and Processing

  • Profile Tool - Plot terrain profiles from raster layers.
  • Processing SAGA NextGen Provider - Processing provider for modern SAGA GIS releases.
  • LF Tools - Cartographic production, surveying, drone mapping, and GNSS tools.
  • ArcGeek Calculator - Coordinate calculations, conversions, and watershed analysis.
  • Fast Density Analysis - Fast kernel density visualization for geospatial analytics.

Plugins / Remote Sensing

  • Semi-Automatic Classification Plugin - Supervised classification of remote sensing imagery.
  • Google Earth Engine Plugin - Google Earth Engine integration for satellite data processing.
  • SRTM-Downloader - Download SRTM elevation tiles from NASA.
  • OpenTopography DEM Downloader - Download DEM data from OpenTopography.org.
  • Freehand Raster Georeferencer - Interactive raster georeferencing by dragging and scaling.

Plugins / Symbology and Cartography

  • SLYR Community Edition - Convert ESRI Style, LYR, and MXD files to QGIS symbology.
  • LAStools - Process point cloud data in LAS and LAZ formats.
  • QuickWKT - Quick WKT and WKB geometry viewer and loader.

Plugins / 3D and Visualization

  • Qgis2threejs - Export 3D visualizations powered by three.js.
  • 3DCityDB Tools - Visualize and manipulate CityGML data from 3D City Database.
  • GEarthView - Display QGIS view in Google Earth.

Plugins / Web Publishing

  • qgis2web - Export projects to OpenLayers or Leaflet web maps.
  • QGIS Cloud Plugin - Publish maps directly on qgiscloud.com.

Plugins / Field and Mobile

  • QField Sync - Synchronize projects with QField mobile app for fieldwork.

Tutorials / Field and Mobile

  • QGIS Tutorials and Tips - Comprehensive step-by-step QGIS tutorials by Ujaval Gandhi.
  • Harvard CGA QGIS Workshop - Academic workshop materials and video tutorials from Harvard.
  • QGIS Documentation Guidelines - Guide for contributing to QGIS documentation.
  • ModernGIS QGIS Certification - Free certification program based on YouTube video tutorials.

Videos / Field and Mobile

  • QGIS Official Channel - Official YouTube channel with demos and conference presentations.
  • Hans van der Kwast - Hydrological applications, PCRaster, and PyQGIS tutorials.
  • Klas Karlsson - Extensive QGIS library from beginner to advanced topics.
  • Sketchy Maps / Map Academy - Over 260 tutorials focused on practical cartography.
  • Spatial Thoughts - Complete courses covering QGIS, Python, and Google Earth Engine.
  • burdGIS - Practical tutorials including Google Earth Engine integration.
  • Open Source Options - Open-source GIS tutorials focusing on QGIS and GDAL.
  • GeoDelta Labs - Geospatial education covering QGIS, GeoPandas, and Python.
  • Luca Congedo - Remote sensing and image classification tutorials.
  • Spatial e-Learning - Free GIS videos on QGIS, machine learning, and remote sensing.
  • Steven Bernard - QGIS Uncovered - Series of 31 progressive video tutorials from basics.

Books / Field and Mobile

  • QGIS Map Design - Guide to creating professional maps in QGIS.
  • Discover QGIS 3.x - Classroom and independent study workbook.
  • QGIS for Hydrological Applications - Processing recipes for catchment hydrology and water resources.
  • Books Page - Full list of QGIS books in multiple languages.

Courses / Field and Mobile

  • Spatial Thoughts Free Courses - Ten free courses from beginner to advanced by Ujaval Gandhi.
  • QGIS Training Certification - Official training organization certification program.

Blogs / Field and Mobile

  • QGIS Blog - Official project blog with news and updates.
  • Planet QGIS - Aggregated posts from community members.
  • burdGIS Blog - Practical QGIS guides and learning materials.
  • North Road Blog - QGIS plugin development insights and open-source GIS tools.

Community / Field and Mobile

  • OSGeo Discourse Forum - Discussion forum for QGIS questions and answers.
  • GIS Stack Exchange - Q&A site for QGIS technical questions.
  • Matrix Chat - Real-time chat room on Matrix and Element.
  • Facebook Group - Official QGIS Facebook community group.
  • Mastodon - QGIS on the Fediverse.
  • Users Mailing List - General user discussion mailing list.
  • Local User Groups - Directory of QGIS user groups worldwide.
  • Commercial Support - Directory of 60+ commercial support providers.

Conferences / Field and Mobile

  • QGIS User Conference - International annual user conference.
  • FOSS4G - International conference for open-source geospatial software.

Mobile and Field Apps / Field and Mobile

  • QField - Professional mobile GIS app, the official QGIS companion for fieldwork.
  • Mergin Maps - Field data collection platform with QGIS project synchronization.

Developer Resources / Field and Mobile

  • PyQGIS Developer Cookbook - Python scripting and automation guide.
  • PyQGIS API - Python API reference for QGIS extensions.
  • C++ API - Native API reference for core development.
  • Plugin Repository - Official repository with 2000+ community plugins.
  • Plugin Publishing Guide - Guide for creating and publishing plugins.
  • Developer Guide - Developer setup and contribution guide.
  • Get Involved - Overview of ways to contribute to QGIS.

QGIS Hub / Field and Mobile

  • QGIS Hub - Community hub for sharing QGIS resources.
  • Styles - Shared map styles and symbologies.
  • Processing Models - Shared processing workflow models.
  • Processing Scripts - Shared processing scripts.
  • Map Gallery - Community map showcase.

Related Lists / Field and Mobile

  • Awesome GIS (⭐5.5k) - Broader GIS resources and tools.
  • Awesome Geospatial (⭐5.3k) - Geospatial tools, databases, and resources.
